settings.label: Benefits
settings.text: Deeply softens rough skin, adds a gentle glow and leaves no heavy film. Works on arms, legs, shoulders and the ends of dry hair.

settings.label: Scent profile
settings.text: Citrus herb opens with bright peel and finishes in green herbs. Lavender is floral and calming. The fragrance-free version contains no added scent at all.

settings.label: How to use
settings.text: Press two to four pumps into your palms and smooth over damp skin after bathing. Use it as a bath addition or mix a drop into body lotion.

settings.image_alt: Oil swirled into a warm bath
settings.label: In the bath
settings.title: Add a few pumps

settings.label: Anytime
settings.title: Highlight shoulders and legs
settings.text: A thin layer on collarbones and shins adds a soft sheen.

settings.label: Will it stain my clothes?
settings.text: Let it absorb for a minute or two before dressing and it will not leave marks on most fabrics.

settings.label: Can I layer it with body butter?
settings.text: Yes. Use the oil first on damp skin, then add butter over the driest areas.

settings.label: Why does the color vary slightly between bottles?
settings.text: The sea extract is a natural ingredient, so the shade can shift a little with each harvest. Quality is the same.

settings.label: Is the bottle recyclable?
settings.text: The pump and bottle are recyclable where facilities exist, and you can return empties to our studio recycling program.
